upstream.revisionPolicy: Evaluation is pinned to this exact material commit. Later Harbor main commits do not inherit qualification automatically.

materialChanges: Adds operator-reviewed replacement runs over exact native errored trial identities with an explicit budget review before submission.
Preserves original executions and artifacts while binding replacement selection to native source evidence and replacement lineage.
Uses Harbor native aggregation for combined results rather than introducing a parallel metric implementation.
Separates Original, Replacements and Combined presentation and distinguishes selected-cohort cost coverage from all-incurred reported cost coverage.
Excludes related subsets from independent leaderboard pooling and withholds pending, invalid or ambiguous assemblies rather than treating them as comparable scalar evidence.

limits: No paid replacement execution was reported in the upstream merge evidence.
No live private-source canary was reported in the upstream merge evidence.
No credential movement or benchmark control action was reported in the upstream merge evidence.

acceptance: Use fixed non-secret synthetic run fixtures and bind Harbor, fixture, original-run and trial identities exactly.
Operator selection must bind original run identity, exact native trial IDs, source-evidence fingerprint, actor and reviewed budget; score-based selection is denied.
Original execution and artifacts remain immutable evidence. Replacement preparation or execution cannot rewrite, relabel or delete original receipts.
Reject source drift, forged or unknown trial IDs, cancelled or invalid originals, stale selection review, overlapping replacement batches and invalid replacement-of-replacement lineage.
Prove idempotency: identical idempotency key and body is stable, conflicting retry bodies are denied, and uncertain submission state cannot silently duplicate replacement work.
Combined results must match the admitted native Harbor aggregation contract on fixed fixtures; do not implement an SZL-only replacement metric path.
Original, replacement and combined related subsets cannot be pooled as independent leaderboard observations. Ambiguous multi-reward or multi-metric objects remain withheld from scalar ranking.
Keep selected-cohort cost and all-incurred cost coverage distinct, enforce reviewed budget ceilings and reject hidden replacement spend.
Preserve private Dataset, LFS and provider-secret isolation inherited from predecessor Harbor waves.
Exercise cancellation, partial result, failure, retry and rollback paths. Rollback target is the exact predecessor local-parent-artifact evaluation contract.
Record all evidence as EVALUATION unless an independent normal gate proves more; successful local fixtures do not authorize paid execution, publication or production benchmark promotion.

deduplication.result: material successor: reviewed replacement selection, lineage, aggregation and leaderboard/cost integrity create a new evaluation-governance boundary

authorityChain.githubSource: exact Harbor mainline commit admitted for bounded evaluation only
authorityChain.huggingFaceProjection: no SZL Harbor worker, model, dataset, Space or paid Job publication is authorized by this wave
authorityChain.productRuntime: no a-11-oy.com product route, provider route or default change is implied
authorityChain.proofEvidence: HOLD until Forge receipts prove replacement selection, lineage, aggregation, cost and rollback invariants at the exact admitted source

alignment.claimBoundary: Operator-reviewed replacement runs are evaluation-recovery infrastructure. They do not convert repeated or repaired benchmark evidence into independent observations, do not authorize paid replacement execution, and do not qualify models or production routes.
